note: He is a business owner and unambiguously a good-to-great case — 5'10", 135 lb, self-reported 12-15% body fat, training three to four times a week plus bouldering, eating whole foods and fasting. He is about as far from the stated exclusion as a prospect can be. But he fails on income and, unusually, on the neglected-health criterion in the opposite direction from most of the corpus: health is not his neglected area, it is the area he already manages. Asked what was going on with his health he said 'Not really, honestly, like, I'd say like I'm fairly healthy. I just want to maintain that and just better myself.' On income he takes no salary, runs business expenses through his personal account and holds most of his money in an account half-owned by his brother. Two things worth carrying to the rollup: at 23 he is far younger than the profile the ICP quote describes, and he said himself that the marketing reads as aimed at 'older people who want to feel young again'. If the corpus shows a cluster of young, lean, cash-poor aesthetic buyers arriving off the same content, that is a targeting finding rather than a rep finding.
